description: Defines the pusch_power_controller class responsible for managing PUSCH power control for a UE, including configuration, handling PHR reports, adapting PRBs, and computing TPC commands.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_power_controller
classes.description: Manages PUSCH power control, including configuration, PHR handling, PRB adaptation, and TPC command computation.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Updates the power control configuration based on new UE cell configuration.

methods.name: handle_phr
methods.description: Processes a PHR report for a specific slot.

methods.name: update_pusch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Stores power control parameters after each PUSCH transmission.

methods.name: adapt_pusch_prbs_to_phr
methods.description: Adjusts the number of PRBs based on PHR.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Calculates TPC command to reach target SINR.
